missing.title: This form does not exist
missing.description: It may have been removed from the site. Pick another form from the sidebar.

list.emptyDescription: Submissions from visitors will appear here as soon as they arrive.

detail.missingEntry: An entry that is no longer available
detail.missingDescription: It may belong to another form or have been removed.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control what is kept about this submission and who can still follow it.

revokeToken.title: Revoke the status link?
revokeToken.description: The visitor will no longer be able to follow this submission. The submission stays in the inbox.

anonymise.title: Anonymise this submission?
anonymise.description: The visitor's details are erased and the status link stops working. The date and status are kept. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete this submission?
delete.description: The submission is removed for good and the status link stops working. This cannot be undone.
